**Subject: Topic classifier – test results**

Hi [Advisor],

Here are the test-set results for the five-class topic classifier (DistilRoBERTa, 1,000 test examples):

| Run | Config | Test accuracy | Test macro-F1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | lr 3e-5, bs 32, no augmentation | 0.806 | 0.805 |
| aug | lr 3e-5, bs 32, augmentation (p=0.3) | 0.829 | 0.828 |
| aug-lr | lr 1e-4, bs 64, augmentation (p=0.3) | N/A | N/A |

Augmentation improves on the baseline by about 2.3 points on both accuracy and macro-F1. The aug-lr run ran out of GPU memory during epoch 7 of 10 and didn't finish, so it has no test results. At epoch 6 its validation accuracy was 0.839, below aug's best of 0.847, but since it stopped early that comparison doesn't settle anything.

**Recommendation:** go with **aug**. If it's worth testing the higher learning rate, I can rerun aug-lr at batch size 32 (or with gradient accumulation) so it fits in memory.

Best,
